answers.why: Nehemiah asks to travel to Judah, the territory containing his fathers' burial city.
Judah is the territorial destination of Nehemiah's journey through the governors' jurisdictions.
The allegation concerns a king ruling in Judah, the Jewish territory.
Many inhabitants in Judah are bound by oath to Tobiah.
The returning exiles go to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own city.
Israel names the people whose returning members are being counted.
The returnees cannot establish whether their ancestry qualifies them as members of Israel.
Israel refers to the returned community living in their cities.
Israel is the nation commanded to observe the law of Moses.
Ephraim names the tribal territory associated with Jerusalem's gate of Ephraim.
The communal sin offerings make atonement for the nation Israel.
The remaining Israelites live in Judah's cities, each on his inheritance.
Judah is identified as the father of Zerah in Pethahiah's genealogy.
Judah identifies the tribal territory associated with divisions of Levites.
Benjamin identifies the tribal territory where divisions of Levites are assigned.
